_comment: Development fixture, not shipped content. One short lesson that exercises ALL FIVE screen types of PLAN.md C3 — intro, block, standard, burst, test (fixed content) and test (source:weak-keys) — so the player can be worked on without waiting for data/lessons/vi/. Open /hoc/#fx-demo/1. The id is deliberately absent from data/curriculum.vi.js, which is what makes player.js fall back to this folder.
